output.answer: Jewel-Osco is owned by Albertsons Companies, Inc. (NYSE: ACI), the Boise, Idaho-based food and drug retailer. Jewel-Osco's own corporate history says it is 'a vital part of Albertsons Inc.' after AB Acquisition LLC, the Albertsons parent entity, acquired it from SUPERVALU in 2013 and later merged with Safeway in 2015. Albertsons' most recent annual report (fiscal year ended February 28, 2026) confirms Jewel-Osco is one of its 22 store banners, so the ownership is unchanged as of November 2026.
caveats: Jewel-Osco's About Us page phrases the relationship as being part of 'Albertsons Inc.'; the listed parent is Albertsons Companies, Inc. (NYSE: ACI), which files the annual report listing Jewel-Osco as a banner. The two names refer to the same corporate family.

Albertsons' proposed merger with Kroger was terminated in December 2024 and Albertsons has since pursued litigation against Kroger; this affects Albertsons' corporate future but does not change Jewel-Osco's current parentage.
